applies_to: structural mesh and structural time-step cases only
trigger: The technically successful coarse free-recovery run produced a 95th-percentile residual stress of approximately 1.75e-8 MPa, below a useful percentage-convergence scale.
disposition_of_initial_run: Retain stage10_structural_mesh_coarse_a01 as a rejected measurand design; do not include it in convergence tables.
revised_boundary: After the force is ramped to zero over 31-32 s, all nodes on the free-end edge are held at UY = 0 through 62 s while remaining free in UX.
interpretation: The 62 s stress is a conditional post-unload stress under an endpoint support, and the top-edge W_max is curvature relative to a least-squares line. Neither is a released annealed-coupon prediction.
